# without SLAM's rules. Kept to test SLAM's citation gate. Gemini's words, quoted.
Under UK case law (such as R v Mukaetova or DPP v Bignell), there is a distinction between unauthorized access to a system versus authorized access used for an unauthorized purpose.
The binding authority on the scope of "unauthorized access" under the CMA is R v Bow Street Magistrates' Court, ex parte Government of the United States of America [2002] 2 AC 216 (House of Lords) (which overturned the earlier, narrower approach in DPP v Bignell [1998] 1 Cr App R 1).
